# Seat Airlines ($SEAT)

> Seat Airlines is a Solana memecoin with a free 3D flight game in the browser.
> Market cap is altitude: the bigger the holders, the higher the plane flies.
> Holders get seats on the plane, and every seat is a billboard.

## What it is

- A community memecoin on Solana: **$SEAT**.
- A free browser game: fly an airliner to 10,000 ft before an engine fails, then keep it airborne as long as you can. An experimental UFO mode climbs through levels — above the clouds, space, the moon, Mars.
- A leaderboard: today's top pilots and the all-time board at https://seat-airlines.space/pilots/
- Full docs: https://seat-airlines.gitbook.io/seat-airlines-docs/

## The token ($SEAT)

- Contract address (Solana): `Bkuddk94i6Y5rRJ94pNzpdDxzvW7CczLPyq4MfN1pump`
- Supply: 1,000,000,000 SEAT.
- Launched on pump.fun: https://pump.fun/coin/Bkuddk94i6Y5rRJ94pNzpdDxzvW7CczLPyq4MfN1pump
- Chart: https://dexscreener.com/solana/Bkuddk94i6Y5rRJ94pNzpdDxzvW7CczLPyq4MfN1pump
- Buy it on pump.fun / PumpSwap with SOL.
- Like any memecoin, the price is volatile and can go to zero. Do your own research.

## Holder perks

- **Seats**: holders sit on the plane's seat map, ranked by bag size. The biggest holders sit up front.
- **Billboards**: every held seat is a billboard — the holder can put a square (1:1) image advert on their seat, shown on the advert wall under the plane.
- **UFO mode**: wallets holding 1,000,000+ $SEAT unlock the experimental UFO interceptor in the game.

## Advertising

- There is no ad-sales desk. Advertising is holder-native: hold $SEAT, take a seat, put your image on it.
- Adverts appear on the seat chart and the advert wall on the homepage, seen by every visitor and player.
- Details: https://seat-airlines.space/faq/#advertising

## The game

- Free to play in any modern browser, desktop or mobile.
- No wallet needed to fly; connect one to post scores to the leaderboard.
- Controls: drag or arrow keys to steer, Space for boost (3 charges).
